newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open unchanged to up 0.10.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open unchanged to up 0.10.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent firmer Friday based on market orders at 1020 EST, dealers said.
But producer selling is expected to limit gains while the previous close below the key 76.00 cents a lb for May delivery puts the market in a technically vulnerable position, they added.
Rainfall in Australia has not been as heavy as previously anticipated, and no major problems are currently seen for cotton in Queensland, Weather Services Corp, said.
Thirty-eight delivery notices were issued today, bringing the total to date to 698 notices.
NYCE cotton futures finished lower Thursday, with May down 0.44 cent at 75.87 cents a lb after trading from 76.00 to 75.60 cents. March settled 0.26 cent lower at 74.20 cents.
Volume was light at an estimated 6,000 lots.
